# People: a real human figure and authored clips for the motion tests

The animation pipeline (#853) is judged on these files, not on the box man (`../gltf/humanoid.glb`), whose clips are generated by our own code. They are committed as test fixtures only. The repo ships importers, not game assets (#342), and this exception covers tests alone.

All three files are by Quaternius and are dedicated to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

| file | what it is | source | sha256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mannequin.glb` | The male mannequin on the UE5 mannequin skeleton (65 joints, fingers and toes), with 43 clips from Universal Animation Library 2 Standard, among them `LayToIdle`, `Hit_Knockback`, `Walk_Carry_Loop` and idles. | `Unreal-Godot/UAL2_Standard.glb` in https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library-2 (zip sha256 `ec0e40d6d78fe9aaad59e322f40865a8675c22f0745e291622e54520391a9217`) | `0815dd05531cae9bc313fc9c0ba81330bc72f8e19ec45f73738e74ddc5796a43` |
| `mannequin_f.glb` | The female mannequin on the same skeleton, with no clips. Clips are retargeted onto it. | `Female Mannequin/Unreal-Godot/Mannequin_F.glb` in the same zip | `2ee6cc3fe888d9b144afa8cc4b2ab7bfc5d13a0d5b7548df777f61f64ad65fa6` |
| `ual1_rigify.glb` | A mannequin on a Rigify-named skeleton (`DEF-hips`, `DEF-thigh.L`, 53 joints), with 46 clips from Universal Animation Library Standard: `Idle_Loop`, `Walk_Loop`, `Jog_Fwd_Loop`, `Sprint_Loop`, crouch, jumps, sitting, hits, death, roll, pistol and sword. | `Godot/AnimationLibrary_Godot_Standard.glb` in https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/universal_animation_librarystandard.zip (zip sha256 `18ff1a7215f4852b320203e8aaf02a1578b5c8eef9027fbaedfcedc7b85a3ac2`) | `1b7bf67866360665426bb99e4c71bd619f19b408453c24e30f0c3071601eee5c` |

Each archive's `License.txt` reads: "CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication. Models by @Quaternius."
